items.t: Applied Digital Sinks 8% as Nebius Outlook and NVIDIA CEO Exit Hit AI Data Center Stocks; Cipher Digital Falls 4%, TeraWulf Slides 3%
items.sum: A weak spending outlook from one AI cloud player and a surprise leadership change at the chip giant have rattled data center landlords. One name carrying heavy debt is feeling the pain most, and its next financing test may decide what comes next.

items.t: Morgan Stanley Just Cut Its Applied Digital Target From $41 to $25
items.sum: Key TakeawaysMorgan Stanley cut its Applied Digital target to $25 from $41 on Nov. 9, keeping its Equal Weight rating.

items.t: Applied Digital (APLD) Could Be 71% Undervalued After CoreWeave Lifted AI Sentiment
items.sum: Applied Digital (APLD) jumped after CoreWeave reported strong AI hardware demand, raised its revenue outlook and showed pricing power, which lifted sentiment toward data center and AI infrastructure peers. items.t: CoreWeave, Applied Digital, And Too Many Leaps Of Faith
items.sum: Both CoreWeave and Applied Digital feature attractive metrics in some key areas. But read why I like APLD stock a bit more than CRWV stock.

items.t: Applied Digital Rallies 8% as CoreWeave’s Results Revive the AI Data Center Trade; Cipher Digital Jumps 10%, IREN Surges 9%
items.sum: After a brutal month, AI data center stocks are snapping back on a single piece of financing news from CoreWeave. But Applied Digital's debt load and a hawkish Fed could still decide whether this bounce holds.

items.t: Applied Digital And Harwood: A Teaching Moment For AI Data Centers?
items.sum: Applied Digital's Polaris Forge 2 site lies between two cities proper, a gray area that pit Harwood, N.D. and Fargo against one another.
